data.description:
# Respawn player in same spot

## Original request (verbatim seed)

> When a player is hit show they should respawn in the same spot. The routine should be: 1) Play SFX
> 2) Play VFX (expand the ship by 50% then contract to normal size) 3) respawn ship in current
> location and orientation (with existing invincibility time out)

## Problem statement

When the player ship is hit in a gym scene it is currently **relocated to a fixed spawn point**
(centre screen) rather than staying where it was hit. The operator wants a hit to read as a short
"damage beat" at the point of impact: play the existing SFX, play a scale VFX (ship grows to 150%
then shrinks back to 100%), then leave the ship at **the same position and orientation** it had when
hit, under the existing post-hit invulnerability window.

## Users

- **Players** — a hit should look and feel like a damage flash on the ship they are flying, not a
  teleport back to the middle of the screen that loses their position in the level.
- **Designers / AI agents implementing AI_Hell** — need one unambiguous, testable rule for
  "respawn in place" so all player-bearing scenes behave identically.

### Example user stories

- As a **player**, I want my ship to stay where it was hit so I keep my position and the hit reads
  as a damage effect rather than a relocation.
- As a **player**, I want a clear visual beat (ship pulses to 150% and back to normal) plus the
  existing hit sound so I understand I was hit and can react.
- As a **developer**, I want the in-place respawn implemented once in the shared player-hit path so
  every gym scene inherits identical behaviour and tests stay cheap.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC1 — In-place respawn:** After a player hit, the ship occupies the **same (x, y)** it had at
  the moment of the hit; it is not relocated to the scene's fixed spawn point
  (`playerSpawnX/Y`, `PLAYER_SPAWN`, or centre screen).
- [ ] **AC2 — Orientation preserved:** The ship's **facing/orientation at the moment of the hit is
  preserved** (the respawn must not reset rotation to 0 / facing to a default).
- [ ] **AC3 — Hit VFX (scale pulse):** The hit plays a visible scale VFX on the ship: scale **expands
  to ~150%** of normal and then **contracts back to 100%**, ending at exactly 1.0 scale. The VFX is
  observable from tests (or deterministically assertable) without pixel comparison.
- [ ] **AC4 — Hit SFX unchanged:** The existing hit/destruction SFX still plays exactly once per hit
  (no double-play, no new audio asset).
- [ ] **AC5 — Invulnerability unchanged:** The post-hit invulnerability window and blink are
  preserved with their existing per-scene values
  (`PLAYER_RESPAWN_INVULNERABLE` = 1.5 s in `GymFormationScene`;
  `COMBAT_HIT_INVULNERABLE_DURATION` = 0.8 s in `GymPowerUpsCombat`), i.e. "existing invincibility
  timeout".
- [ ] **AC6 — Scope consistent:** The in-place respawn applies to **every player-hit path** —
  `GymFormationScene._hitPlayer()` (inherited by `GymEnemies`, `GymBoss`, and the formation gyms) and
  `GymPowerUpsCombat._hitPlayer()` — so no scene keeps the old relocate-to-spawn behaviour.
- [ ] **AC7 — Testing/validation:** Unit/scene tests cover: (a) the ship's post-hit position equals
  its pre-hit position; (b) facing is preserved; (c) the scale pulse runs 1.0 → 1.5 → 1.0; (d) SFX
  fires once; (e) invulnerability is set and the ship cannot be hit again while invulnerable. All
  tests pass.
- [ ] **AC8 — Documentation:** `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` §7.2 ("Collisions &
  respawn", currently "the ship respawns at its spawn position") is updated to the in-place rule, and
  the superseded AC4 of "Player should spawn center screen" (AH-0MTVYBCUW008BEQT) is noted. All
  related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code comments, README, and any
  relevant wiki or docs site entries.
- [ ] **AC9 — Test suite:** Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Constraints

- **No new audio asset** — reuse the existing destruction SFX (`playDestructionSound`).
- **No change to lives/score model** — the player is never destroyed (infinite lives in gyms); only
  the respawn location/orientation and the hit VFX change.
- **No change to the collision radii or hit conditions** that trigger `_hitPlayer()`.
- **Deterministic tests preferred** — Phaser tweens are awkward to assert; expose an observable seam
  (e.g. a tracked scale-VFX handle or a `getPlayerHitVfx()` accessor) rather than relying on
  wall-clock tween completion.
- **Merge-order awareness** — `GymFormationScene.ts` is a shared core library touched by many gym
  items; keep the diff surgical.

## Existing state

- `GymFormationScene._hitPlayer()` (`src/scenes/gym/core/GymFormationScene.ts`, ~line 834):
  increments `playerHitCount`, calls `playDestructionSound()`, calls
  `_spawnPlayerExplosion(player.x, player.y)` (particle burst, `SHIP_COLOR`/`SHIP_SIZE`), then
  `this.player.respawn(this.playerSpawnX, this.playerSpawnY)` and sets
  `playerInvulnerable = PLAYER_RESPAWN_INVULNERABLE` (1.5 s) with blink reset.
- `playerSpawnX/Y` are captured at `create()` from `config.player.x/y` (centre screen,
  `PLAYER_SPAWN = { x: 480, y: 270 }` per AH-0MTVYBCUW008BEQT).
- `Player.respawn(x, y)` (`src/entities/Player.ts`, ~line 800) **hard-resets** the movement state to
  `{ x, y, vx: 0, vy: 0, facing: 0 }`, calls `setRotation(0)`, zeroes thruster flames and stops the
  thruster hum — i.e. it currently discards both velocity **and orientation**.
- `GymPowerUpsCombat._hitPlayer()` (`src/scenes/gym/GymPowerUpsCombat.ts`, ~line 657) independently
  hard-codes a relocate to `GAME_WIDTH/2, GAME_HEIGHT/2`, zeroes velocity, plays
  `playDestructionSound()`, and starts invulnerability = `COMBAT_HIT_INVULNERABLE_DURATION` (0.8 s).
  It has **no** particle/scale VFX.
- Particle burst VFX for player death was introduced by "Wire particle VFX to death paths"
  (AH-0MTVID8RQ002DJ0J) as the **primary** death VFX for both entities and the player.
- `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` §7.2 ("Collisions & respawn", ~lines 406–417) documents
  the current relocate-to-spawn behaviour; ~line 416 states "the ship respawns at its spawn
  position".
- Superseded/sibling context: "Player should spawn center screen" (AH-0MTVYBCUW008BEQT) AC4
  explicitly required "the respawn position matches the initial spawn position (center screen)" —
  this item **inverts** that rule.

## Desired change

On a player hit, run exactly this sequence at the ship's current position:

1. **SFX** — play the existing destruction sound once.
2. **VFX** — scale the ship up to ~150% and back down to 100% (a single expand/contract pulse).
3. **Respawn** — leave the ship at its **current location and current orientation** and start the
   **existing** post-hit invulnerability window (blink). Velocity handling: **see OPEN QUESTION 2**.

No relocation to the fixed spawn point, and no orientation reset.

## Key Files (predicted)

- `src/scenes/gym/core/GymFormationScene.ts` — `_hitPlayer()` becomes in-place; add the scale-VFX
  pulse (and an observable seam); keep SFX + `PLAYER_RESPAWN_INVULNERABLE`.
- `src/entities/Player.ts` — `respawn()` needs a variant/mode that preserves position **and**
  orientation (currently forces `facing: 0` / `setRotation(0)`); or a new `respawnInPlace()`.
- `src/scenes/gym/GymPowerUpsCombat.ts` — `_hitPlayer()` must adopt the same in-place + VFX + SFX
  behaviour (currently hard-codes centre-screen relocation and has no VFX).
- `src/core/constants.ts` — possibly a `PLAYER_HIT_SCALE_PEAK` (1.5) / pulse-duration constant.
- `src/scenes/gym/core/GymFormationScene.test.ts`, `src/scenes/gym/GymPowerUpsCombat.test.ts`,
  `src/entities/Player.test.ts` — update/extend tests for position, orientation, scale pulse, SFX,
  invulnerability.
- `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` — §7.2 collisions/respawn wording.

## Related work

- **Player should spawn center screen (AH-0MTVYBCUW008BEQT)** — **direct conflict**: its AC4 requires
  respawn to relocate to the centre-screen spawn point; this item reverses that. Needs an explicit
  supersede decision (see OPEN QUESTION 1).
- **Wire particle VFX to death paths (AH-0MTVID8RQ002DJ0J)** — introduced the particle burst as the
  *primary* player-death VFX, including `_spawnPlayerExplosion`; the requested scale VFX overlaps
  this (see OPEN QUESTION 3).
- **Implement: Core scene — collision detection and player hit/respawn (AH-0MTECNG8W00403EH)** —
  created the original hit → SFX + explosion + respawn-at-spawn + invulnerability path.
- **Test: Core scene — collision detection and player hit/respawn (AH-0MTECNG4K0071TIB)** — existing
  hit/respawn test coverage that will need updating.
- **If player crashes into an enemy, they both die (AH-0MTV7JOLU006W8PT)** — the entity-collision
  branch also calls `_hitPlayer()`; it inherits whatever this item decides.
- **Implement/Test: Wipe detection, 3s countdown, and respawn in GymFormationScene
  (AH-0MTHCD0BQ000JFZ4 / AH-0MTHCFDAD009B3JG)** — the *formation* respawn lifecycle (unrelated
  mechanism, same file and same `respawn` vocabulary — do not conflate).
- **Extract reusable gym formation-scene core library (AH-0MTAN4IFR007U9B3)** — why the player-hit
  logic lives in one shared base class.

## Risks and assumptions

- **Risk — reversing a producer-approved AC:** AH-0MTVYBCUW008BEQT AC4 (approved 2026-09-13) is
  directly contradicted. **Mitigation:** treat OPEN QUESTION 1 as blocking; do not implement until
  the operator confirms the supersede.
- **Risk — VFX collision with the particle burst:** the scale pulse may visually clash with, or be
  intended to replace, the particle explosion (AH-0MTVID8RQ002DJ0J). **Mitigation:** OPEN QUESTION 3.
- **Risk — orientation is not currently recoverable after `respawn()`:** `Player.respawn()` discards
  `facing`; the implementer must capture position/orientation **before** calling any reset, or add an
  in-place variant. Tests must assert the exact pre-hit facing (not merely "unchanged"), so a silent
  reset-to-0 cannot pass.
- **Assumption (proposed, pending answers):** velocity/momentum is reset to zero while position and
  orientation are kept — i.e. the ship stays *parked* at the hit spot (OPEN QUESTION 2).
- **Assumption (low-risk):** "expand the ship by 50%" means peak scale 1.5× of the ship's normal
  scale, returning to exactly 1.0.
- **Scope-creep risk:** keep the change to the hit/respawn beat only. Extra ideas surfaced while
  planning (e.g. brief slow-motion on hit, hit-screen shake, per-scene VFX variation, hit-count UI)
  must be recorded as **linked new work items**, not folded into this one.
- **Assumption:** `GymPlayer` has no hit logic, so it is out of scope unless the operator says
  otherwise.

## Appendix: clarifying questions & answers

No answers received yet — questions were recorded on the work item and the item was flagged for
producer review (see `wl show AH-0MU3VQ0JR009CSIN --comments`). All three are **OPEN QUESTION**s.

- Q1: "Respawn in place **supersedes** AC4 of *Player should spawn center screen*
  (AH-0MTVYBCUW008BEQT), which required respawn to relocate to the centre-screen spawn point. Should
  the in-place rule replace the relocate-to-spawn rule in **all** player-hit scenes (GymFormationScene
  base → GymEnemies / GymBoss / formation gyms, plus GymPowerUpsCombat)? [Proposed: yes — respawn in
  place everywhere, old AC4 superseded.]" — **Answer: OPEN QUESTION.** Source: recorded as a comment
  on AH-0MU3VQ0JR009CSIN; awaiting producer.
- Q2: "At the moment of a hit, should the ship **keep its pre-hit velocity/momentum** (so it carries on
  drifting after the VFX), or be **stopped dead** at the hit spot while preserving position and
  facing? [Proposed: stopped dead — position + orientation preserved, velocity zeroed, matching the
  existing `respawn()` behaviour for velocity.]" — **Answer: OPEN QUESTION.** Source: recorded as a
  comment on AH-0MU3VQ0JR009CSIN; awaiting producer.
- Q3: "Does the expand-to-150%-then-contract scale VFX **replace** the existing particle-explosion
  burst on player hit (`_spawnPlayerExplosion`, added as the *primary* death VFX by
  AH-0MTVID8RQ002DJ0J), or **play in addition to** it? [Proposed: replace for the player hit (one
  clear damage beat); keep entities' particle bursts unchanged.]" — **Answer: OPEN QUESTION.** Source:
  recorded as a comment on AH-0MU3VQ0JR009CSIN; awaiting producer.
- Research note: the player-hit path was read directly at `GymFormationScene.ts:697–843`,
  `GymPowerUpsCombat.ts:657–675` and `Player.ts:800`. The centre-screen spawn rule and its AC4
  wording were read from AH-0MTVYBCUW008BEQT; the particle-burst-as-primary-VFX decision from
  AH-0MTVID8RQ002DJ0J AC1–AC3. Invulnerability constants: `PLAYER_RESPAWN_INVULNERABLE = 1.5` and
  `COMBAT_HIT_INVULNERABLE_DURATION = 0.8` in `src/core/constants.ts`.
## Related work (automated report)

### Related work items
- **AH-0MT7USMWN0071UF5** – Clarify enemy pass-through and bullet-blocking rules in GDD (Wall vs Dive Bomb) (completed)
- **AH-0MTVYBY430008GB2** – Diver should always turn to face the player (completed)
- **AH-0MTAN4T0I004H187** – Rewrite GymTank gym scene on the core library (completed)

### Repository file matches
- `README.md` — matched: ac3, ac4, ac5, acceptance, add (+267 more)
- `docs/Game Design Document.md` — matched: ac1, ac2, ac3, ac4, ac5 (+264 more)
- `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` — matched: ac1, ac4, accessor, add, added (+233 more)

question: Intake draft written and attached to the description, but three answers are needed before the brief can be finalised and the stage advanced to intake_complete.

Q1 — Supersede old respawn rule: AH-0MTVYBCUW008BEQT (Player should spawn center screen) AC4 explicitly required 'the respawn position matches the initial spawn position (center screen)'. This item requests respawn in place, which directly contradicts that approved AC. Should the in-place rule replace the relocate-to-spawn rule in ALL player-hit scenes (GymFormationScene base → GymEnemies / GymBoss / formation gyms, plus GymPowerUpsCombat)? [Proposed: yes — respawn in place everywhere; the old AC4 is superseded.]

Q2 — Velocity at respawn: at the moment of a hit, should the ship keep its pre-hit velocity/momentum (so it carries on drifting after the VFX) or be 'stopped dead' at the hit spot while preserving position and facing? [Proposed: stopped dead — position + orientation preserved, velocity zeroed, matching existing behaviour.]

Q3 — VFX relationship: does the expand-to-150%-then-contract scale VFX replace the existing particle-explosion burst on player hit (_spawnPlayerExplosion, added as the primary death VFX by AH-0MTVID8RQ002DJ0J), or play in addition to it? [Proposed: replace for the player hit; entities' bursts unchanged.]

Context: current code relocates the player to the fixed spawn point (_hitPlayer → player.respawn(playerSpawnX, playerSpawnY) in GymFormationScene.ts:834-843; GymPowerUpsCombat.ts:657-675 hard-codes GAME_WIDTH/2, GAME_HEIGHT/2). Player.respawn() also discards orientation (facing: 0, setRotation(0)). Full draft brief is in the item description.
